## Boundary checks

- [ ] The change contains no secret, private source, generated target, binary, cache, or local absolute path.
- [ ] Observed behavior is separated from interpretation and future hypotheses.
- [ ] No sealed POC is silently rewritten in place; integrity/version records are handled explicitly.
- [ ] GCL remains the constitutional authority root and subordinate jurisdictions remain bounded.
- [ ] Relevant Cargo builds, tests, and extraction checks pass.
